title: A lawsuit has been filed against Capital News correspondent Mehmet Yıldız
paragraphs: Capital News correspondent Mehmet Yıldız has been indicted on charges of violation of the investigation's confidentiality due to a report of testimony in a murder investigation.

According to the indictment, Mehmet Yıldız violated the confidentiality of the investigation with the report of a murder investigation published on 3 November 2025. The sentence is carried out: the Turkish Penal Code 285 (infringement of the confidentiality of the investigation).
The indictment was approved by Ankara 12th Criminal Court of Asliye on 15 January 2026. The first hearing will be held on 2 April 2026.
In the Mehmet Yıldız case, Attorney Orhan Bilgin said they have been restricted access to some documents in the file and it undermines their defence rights.
Mehmet Yıldız works as an Ankara correspondent at a broadcast agency called D.C. News. Press occupational organisations have announced that they are closely monitoring the case.
The prosecutor's office is demanding a 1 to 3 year sentence for Mehmet Yıldız. Mehmet Yıldız is being tried without arrest.
